deterministic_title_consistency.reason: Holdout strict-identity precision 100.0%, recall 73.3%; permissive assistive path precision 100.0%, recall 80.0%. The complete title-consistency feature remains deferred because it does not meet the 95.0% recall target and non-identity cases require human review. Best end-to-end extracted track paddle-medium:blind: precision 100.0%, recall 71.4%.

embeddings.reason: Lexical ranking already surfaces the relevant candidate inside an assistive shortlist, so embeddings are not justified in Phase 0. Revisit only if a later representative corpus shows lexical misses.

fuzzy_title_scoring.reason: Among non-equality cases the weighted lexical score spans 0.766-0.830 for true matches and 0.187-0.847 for material mismatches; the ranges overlap, so no single threshold separates OCR noise from a one-token substitution. 0 case(s) were decided by the threshold branch. Only the equality, alias, subtitle and deterministic glyph-confusion paths are bounded identity evidence; anything else belongs in a human review queue rather than an automatic decision.

generative_local_llm.reason: No Phase 0 task required generative authority and no generative model was executed. Deterministic and specialist baselines resolve the measured problems first.

harper.reason: Measured precision 50.0% and recall 52.6% across 32 untuned technical-English cases, with 10 false positives on 18 deliberately clean cases.

languagetool.reason: Measured precision 56.0% and recall 73.7% across 32 untuned technical-English cases, with 11 false positives on 18 deliberately clean cases.

lexical_duplicate_detection.reason: Holdout Recall@1 100.0%, Recall@5 100.0% against a 42-candidate shared pool; irrelevant candidate rate 30.0% at the calibration-selected threshold 0.3. Selected only for ranked candidate generation and human review, not authoritative duplicate classification.

native_pdfium_extraction.reason: Measured born-digital title recovery 100.0% (exact after normalization) across 8 cases.

paddle_medium.reason: Measured exact title recovery 92.6%, mean WER 11.4%; the complete OCR quality gate requires at least 95.0% exact recovery and at most 12.0% mean WER. Runtime and memory do not override that gate, and Phase 0 has not measured a safe automatic escalation policy.

paddle_small.reason: Measured exact title recovery 88.9%, mean WER 14.6%; the complete OCR quality gate requires at least 95.0% exact recovery and at most 12.0% mean WER. Runtime and memory do not override that gate, and Phase 0 has not measured a safe automatic escalation policy.

paddle_tiny.reason: Measured exact title recovery 85.2%, mean WER 11.3%; the complete OCR quality gate requires at least 95.0% exact recovery and at most 12.0% mean WER. Runtime and memory do not override that gate, and Phase 0 has not measured a safe automatic escalation policy.

strict_title_identity_check.reason: Holdout strict-identity precision 100.0%. This primitive accepts only documented safe identity paths (normalized equality, approved aliases, explicitly allowed subtitles and the narrow glyph-confusion rule); it is selected for safe agreement, not title-validation recall.

tesseract.reason: Measured exact title recovery 85.2%, mean WER 16.0%; the complete OCR quality gate requires at least 95.0% exact recovery and at most 12.0% mean WER. Runtime and memory do not override that gate, and Phase 0 has not measured a safe automatic escalation policy.

vision_language_model.reason: No VLM was executed. Specialist OCR already recovers titles from the measured poster corpus, so a VLM has no demonstrated Phase 0 role.

environment.gpu: not queried by the portable harness; CPU mode is authoritative for this run

duplicates.note: Ranking sees only candidate title and text. Relevance labels, relation labels and split membership are attached after ranking and never affect the score or the candidate ordering.
duplicates.threshold_selection: Calibration split only, maximising flagged-candidate F1 then precision then the stricter threshold; holdout is scored once with the selected value.

harper.note: No custom dictionary or rule tuning was applied to either engine, so calibration and holdout measure the same untuned configuration and neither split is contaminated by the other. 'projected_precision_with_domain_dictionary' is a diagnostic upper bound describing what precision would be if every dictionary-category false positive were resolved by a curated domain vocabulary. It is arithmetic on the measured findings, not a measured result, and no dictionary was built.

languagetool.memory_note: local LanguageTool server peak working set

grammar.language_note: Both engines are configured for Australian English and every clean corpus case is written in Australian English, so dialect mismatch cannot inflate the false-positive count.

native.note: Character-count and printable-ratio signals are observations only, not a production OCR gate.

paddle-medium.limitation: Whole-text WER includes reading-order effects and is unbounded above: a page whose text is detected in a different linear order, or one where noise adds spurious words, can exceed 100% while its title is recovered perfectly. Title metrics are therefore reported separately. Oversized and empty controls are processed but excluded from aggregate quality and from scored latency.
paddle-medium.memory_note: Peak working set of the whole benchmark process. It is monotonic and includes every model already loaded in this process, so it is attributable to this engine only when the variant is the single engine of its run. Compare with a child-process figure only with that caveat.
